name: Desktop app (GTK 4, Python)
description: A real desktop window: GTK 4 through Python's GObject bindings, both in the image. A header bar, a list, an entry, and a settings file. Follows the Genesis day/night theme.
hints: Change the window in app.py: widgets in Window.__init__, behaviour in on_add and the list row. Run it once to see the window; there is no web preview.
